_comment: Target description read by hyb-partition, hyb-npu-tile, hyb-npu-memplan and the NPU backend. LP6: four LPDDR6 channels (8 subchannels x 2 ranks, dram-pim configs/LPDDR6_PIM_Mobile_4CH.ini), run with IESLAB_NPU_Simulator/plena_settings.toml (runtime/decode.py default). configs/target_1ch.json is one channel (the LP6 of the Part 3 results). npu.lp6_read_gbps is the 36-layer NPU-only W8A8 step on four channels (4.02 GB in 71.6 ms, 2026-09-30); pim.efficiency is still the one-channel fit (runtime/calibrate.py, 2026-09-26); the boundary costs (act_write_*, readback_*) and gemv_fixed_us are estimates from the former hybrid_bench (workspace docs/PERFORMANCE.md, 2026-09-21 hybrid bench results §19.1), not fitted. None of these values is from the LPDDR6-PIM PDF. pim.concurrent_ranks remains false to preserve the existing calibration and baseline; it is not required by an absence of cross-rank PIM timing. Draft 13.6 maps PIMX to base Meta commands, whose cross-rank 2 CK in the supported WCK-always-on/ODT-off profile is enforced by the shared CA scheduler. true permits both ranks to compute while sharing external DQ. See the workspace docs/research/PIM_RANK_REFRESH_FEED.md (rank-overlap spec and two-rank baseline sections) for validation and remaining protocol/input-feed limits.
